title: lvbelC5 totem pack
description: This small resource pack replaces the standard Negativity Totem texture in Minecraft with a photograph by the famous artist LvbelC5. It does not cause any performance issues and is intended solely for entertainment purposes.
body:
This fun resource pack completely replaces the game's standard, boring Totem of Undying texture. Now, whenever you pick up the totem or it explodes, the iconic pose of renowned artist LvbelC5 will appear on your screen!
"![Minecraft lvbelC5 Totem Görüntüsü](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3e6ff7999c30a303905f457adf21e93e4bbb6e0.jpeg)
